pattern.description: RF bus 4-dword write sequence: set addr_lo/hi/data/ctrl then trigger at 0x2007fed0
pattern.template_c: *((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fef0U) = addr; *((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fef4U) = 0U; *((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fef8U) = data; *((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fefcU) = ctrl; *((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fed0U) = trig;  /* REG_2007_fed0 */
